nodes.label: Eight Interactive States
nodes.rationale: Hover without focus or vice versa excludes keyboard users; all eight states from default to success must be designed.

nodes.label: Focus Ring
nodes.rationale: Removing outline without replacement violates accessibility; focus-visible shows ring only for keyboard users.

nodes.label: Popover and Anchor Positioning
nodes.rationale: Absolute dropdowns clip inside overflow hidden; top layer plus anchor positioning or portal escapes clipping without z-index wars.
